extra.reason: Vite 8 + React 19 + TS 7 + tldraw 5.5 scaffold; dev/build/typecheck/test scripts; vitest passing.

Array shape + tool done: drag grows cells every cell-width in any of 4 directions, random ints 0-99, stable values on shrink/regrow, indices, colour/size/font styles, Esc cancel, single-step undo, SVG export. Verified with 13 unit tests and a headless-Chrome drive.

Shared cell editing layer (src/cells: EditableCells + CellShapeUtil) with arrays as first user. Double-click/Enter to edit, Tab/arrows/click to move, Enter/click-away commit, Esc reverts current cell, per-cell undo. 7 new unit tests; verified in headless Chrome incl. focus race on double-click.
SKILL.md + driver.mjs written; every code block re-run verbatim (setup, two driver scripts, human path, tests).
Decided: one model-driven shape per structure; proven by the linked list (render, edit, drag, export, undo).

src/nodelink/geometry.ts + SceneSvg.tsx: circle/box/list nodes, clipped straight edges, curved antiparallel twins, self-loops, arrowheads, edge labels, null/label annotations; pointer arrows take the shortest path. 16 vitest; list rendered in app; circles/curves/loops/labels checked visually via a rendered sample scene (light + dark).
mulberry32 seeded PRNG; fillValues(mode, seed, n) is deterministic and prefix-stable for random modes; seed stored on array and list shapes; changing Fill regenerates from the seed.

sceneCells derives EditableCells from any Scene (node keys = ids, edge-label cells 'edge:<key>', round input for circles, Tab order = scene order, arrows spatial). Verified in app on list nodes (dblclick, Tab, shortcut letters stay text); circle/edge-label paths unit-tested, first in-app use comes with trees/graphs.
Vertex handles on node bottom edges; onHandleDrag stores per-node offsets; edges follow live; one undo per drag; Re-layout context-menu action resets. Verified in app and e2e (list).
drawds:fill StyleProp + Fill dropdown picker in the style panel (6 icon modes, translations); sticky for next shapes; on selected shapes regenerates values from seed (one undo step). e2e covered.
@playwright/test with installed Chrome, playwright.config.ts (webServer on 5179), e2e/*.e2e.ts: arrays, lists, fill, migration (10 tests, stable under --repeat-each=3). npm run test:e2e.

Singly linked list: Shift+N / toolbar, drag in 4 directions, [value|next] nodes, head label, null marker, editable values, draggable nodes, one undo, Esc cancels, export. Unit + e2e + driver verified.
Array migration AddFillAndSeed (v1) + empty list sequence; unit test + e2e load of a v0 snapshot via editor.loadSnapshot.
Fill modes random/empty/ascending/descending/nearly-sorted/letters via the style panel; range split to dds-55z.22.
Wave 2 complete: node-link kit, seeded fills, node editing/dragging, style-panel options, e2e harness.

Grow grip for arrays (both axes) and lists (4 directions): create-type handle + '+' glyph past the end; grownCount/extendValues pure + unit tests (59 total); e2e grow.e2e.ts (5 tests, x4 stable) incl. typed values kept, seeded continuation, head fixed for left lists, Esc, undo.

Delete any node via an x badge per node (HTML RemoveButton; predecessor rewires, list closes the gap, head removal promotes next node in place); insert/remove at head via a start grip and at tail via the end grip; anchorShift keeps surviving nodes fixed on the page. Pure ops + 11 unit tests, e2e list-edit (5 tests x3). Middle insertion split to dds-55z.16.4.

+ button mid-way along each next pointer (incl. tail->null) inserts after its node; value via insertValue (between neighbours for sorted fills); new node opens for editing via CellShapeUtil.editCell; one undo for the insert, one for the typed value. Generic insertOnEdge/canInsertOnEdge hook in NodeLinkShapeUtil (reusable for trees/graphs). 77 unit, 22 e2e (stable x2-3).
Node x / edge + appear only near the pointer (hover.ts, 16px reach; grips always shown); coarse pointers show all. Driver 'hover' command + e2e hoverNode helper; list-edit e2e updated and extended.
random/letters draw without replacement (sorted modes strictly monotone) until the pool runs out; extend/insert skip present values; new 'repeats' fill mode keeps duplicates. 8 new unit tests.
Contour-based tidy layout for binary trees (lone child offset < half sibling spacing; nulls as phantom leaves); normalised; drag offsets; 16 unit tests incl. no-overlap and parentage clarity.
randomTreePaths(seed, depth, fullness): exact depth via seeded spine, existence by hash(seed, path) so deeper/fuller only adds nodes; ids n+path; random values per perfect-tree index (stable).

Binary tree shape + tool (Shift+T): press root, drag down for levels, lean for fullness (stick..perfect); circle nodes, editable values, draggable nodes, export; createDragTool generalises the sketch tools. e2e tree.e2e.ts.
Hover a node: + per empty child slot on its lower corners (opens the new child for editing), x removes the subtree (not the root); root stays put; one undo each. e2e.
drawds:nulls style prop + style panel toggle; null markers in every empty slot, laid out as phantom leaves. e2e.

Marks on any element: keys 1-4/0 on the element under the pointer (tldraw numbered toolbar shortcuts disabled), Mark submenu in the context menu, stored per shape (array/list/tree migrations), rendered on canvas and export, pruned on removal, swapped with values. Unit + e2e (marks.e2e.ts, migration).
Per-cell handles; drag onto another cell swaps values + marks (one undo, Esc cancels), ghost + dashed target while dragging, CSS arc animation on swap. Vertical arrays too. e2e swap.e2e.ts.

BST is a tree kind (drawds:tree-kind): sketched shapes get sorted keys in in-order (always valid; lean = degenerate..balanced); switching a tree to BST keeps its keys and sorts them into place. Tree props migration v2.
Heap shape + tool (Shift+P): drag right inserts one value per cell (fills level order); min/max style with Floyd rebuild; values editable in either view.
Backing array drawn under the tree; editing either view edits the same slot; pointing at an index highlights it (blue), its parent (orange) and children (green) in both views; marks shown in both.

Insert-a-key prompt animates the comparison path then the new node; x deletes with leaf / one child / successor cases; duplicates found not inserted; highlights fade, Shift keeps them as marks; one undo. e2e bst.e2e.ts.

Heap insert (append + sift-up) and remove/extract (last into the gap + sift down/up) play as chains of swap arcs in tree and array; playback engine (frames then one-step commit) in src/nodelink/playback.ts. e2e heap.e2e.ts.

Wave 3 core done: lists sketched, edited, grown, step-by-step operations. Variants (dds-55z.16.1) moved up a level.
Wave 4 core done: random binary trees, edits, traversals. n-ary trees (dds-55z.17.4) moved up; mirror (dds-55z.17.6) to teaching moves.
Wave 5 core done: BST kind and heaps with animated operations. Invariant checker (dds-55z.18.4) moved to teaching moves.

CellShapeUtil hosts nodeOperations/shapeOperations/playbackLayout and the operation prompt; arrays draw frames (values, marks, flash, dim, swap/move slides); step pointers drawn in the play overlay; play bar shows counts. Unit + e2e tests.

Binary search (lo/mid/hi, discarded half faded, unsorted warning step lighting the first out-of-order pair, crossing pointers incl. -1/n) plus linear search for contrast; comparisons counter. Context menu Search submenu, value prompt.

Insertion (swap-based), selection, bubble (early exit) sorts step by step: i/j/min pointers, orange compared pair, swap arcs, green settled region, comparisons/swaps counts in the play bar. Sort step by step submenu.
Array submenu: Sort, Sort descending, Shuffle, Reverse (values arc to their new cells, marks travel), New values (fresh seed), Show/Hide indices. Each one undo step.

Lomuto partition around the last value (pivot red, smaller values blue, i from lo-1 incl. the -1 slot, j orange, pivot swaps into place green) and full quicksort: range faded outside lo..hi, call stack strip of open calls, emptied at the end. Hoare left for a follow-up.
drawds.css: system sans-serif on .tl-container, 13px for tldraw buttons/labels, tooltips, toasts, dialogs and the style panel picker; kbd hints 12px.

Step by step (context menu) plus quick hover controls: x on the hovered cell's corner deletes it, + on the nearest boundary (lower end) inserts a fill-mode value and opens it for typing; later values slide straight over; marks travel; one undo step each; touch shows all buttons.

Search for a node's key or a typed key (BST node context menu, Search submenu): curr walks down from the root narrated as code, each ruled-out subtree fades (new dim support in SceneSvg, edges touching faded nodes fade too), comparisons counter, falls off at null (pointer on the null marker when nulls are shown).

Heap menu (shapeOperations): Build heap step by step (Floyd: leaves green, each parent from the last back sifts down with swap arcs in both views, green region grows as a suffix of the array / bottom-up in the tree, swaps counter) and Shuffle values (breaks the heap so building it has work to do). Heapify-this-array via the invariant checker stays with dds-55z.18.4.

src/shapes/graph/algorithms.ts: Dijkstra (distance badges from ∞, best edge into each node green and re-routed on improvement, priority-queue strip, updates count, negative-weight warning, unweighted counts 1), Prim from a node (crossing edges lit, cheapest added, total weight), Kruskal (edges cheapest first strip, cycle-closing edges flashed red, forest when disconnected), topological sort (Kahn: in-degree badges, queue + order strips, placed nodes and removed edges fade, cycle reported, final order numbered). Menu: Dijkstra/Prim on nodes, Graph algorithms submenu (Kruskal undirected, topological sort directed). Strips widen for long items; dim fades edge:<key> too.

Find the middle (slow one step, fast two; even counts end on the second middle, fast at null) and Insert in order (prompt; prev/curr walk to the first value not smaller, then the two assignments narrated with prev; warns when the list isn't sorted). Cycle detection split to dds-55z.20.2.7 (needs circular lists, dds-55z.16.1).

Hoare partition (i/j walk in from the off-end slots, swap out-of-place pairs, cross; pivot tracked red; narration notes it isn't necessarily in place), merge sort (call stack + merged strips, taken values fade, copy-back arcs each value into place, comparisons/copies), and the play bar speed control (½x-4x). Counting sort left as dds follow-up.

Length picker (grows / fixed) in the style panel; props sizing + used (migration, unit + e2e load check). Fixed: blank spare slots behind a heavier size line, 'size · capacity' under the indices, grip changes capacity (never below size), spare slots not editable / markable / draggable, operations and instant actions work on the used part, hover x keeps capacity, + only while there is room. Switching back to grows drops the spare slots (one undo).

Fixed mode: Insert / delete step by step (insert shifts into the spare slot then size++, full array stops with one step pointing at Grow; delete shifts left, last used slot blank, size--) and Capacity > Append a value (a[size] = v, size++; grows to twice the capacity first when full). Unit + e2e.

Capacity > Grow: double the capacity. Frames gained a second row (props.aux: newArr = new int[2c], aligned cells, title, indices) under a horizontal array (right of a vertical one); values arc down a[i] -> newArr[i] one step each (copies counted), then a = newArr moves them up into the longer array. Geometry and the play bar include the row; moves keyed aux:<i>; crossSlides in swap.ts.

Capacity > Append 8 values, doubling / growing by one when full: each grow is newArr + copy-all + replace in three steps, appends and copies counted (from a full 4: doubling 12 copies for 8 appends, +1 60 copies), the last step names amortised O(1) vs O(n) per append.
All four children done: Length option (grows / fixed, size and spare slots), fixed insert / delete / append step by step, Grow with a second row, append-many doubling vs +1.

Bar anchored at the structure's left edge, buttons first in fixed places (fixed-width step counter), counts then caption last; the bar is top-aligned so a wrapping caption grows downwards. Strips and bar placed once per operation from every step's extent (playbackLayout(shape, frame) -> left/bottom; view.frames), so they never move while it plays. e2e checks button positions across a sort and a grow.

Kind picker array / stack / queue (StyleProp drawds:array-kind; props kind + front; migration with unit + e2e load check). Stacks stand upright (layout axis 'up' in the metrics: index 0 at the bottom at the origin, which rises as cells come so index 0 stays put; boundaries, indices, grip, sketching up from the press point) with a built-in top marker. Queues lie in a row with front / rear markers; fixed = circular buffer (spare slots per cell, may wrap; unwrapped when it becomes something else or its capacity changes). Built-in markers: CellShapeUtil.markerPointers, laid out with the pointers, not interactive (ids '@...'). Plain arrays keep swap handles and quick x / +.

Stack submenu: Push (fill mode's next value), Push a value... (prompt at the top cell via NodeOperation.promptAt), Pop (value to a 'popped' strip, slot blank, top drops), Peek. Fixed and full: stack overflow, nothing changes; empty: underflow; growing: a new cell on top / the cell goes. Capacity > Grow for fixed stacks (and queues). src/shapes/array/stack-queue.ts + tests.

Queue submenu: Enqueue / Enqueue a value... / Dequeue / Peek. Circular buffer: a[rear] = v then rear = (rear + 1) % capacity, narrated when it wraps; full when size = capacity; dequeue frees a[front], front moves on, nothing else moves. Growing (a list): enqueue appends; dequeue shifts every value left (moves counted) and says why circular buffers. Grow copies a circular buffer in queue order so its front lands at 0.

Always-visible buttons while a stack / queue is the only selected shape: stack + push at the top cell's top-left corner, x pop at its top-right (none when empty); queue + enqueue under the rear slot, x dequeue under the front cell, nudged apart for when they meet. They play the operations with the fill mode's next value.

Stacks and queues done: kind picker (upright stack with top; queue with front / rear, circular buffer when fixed), push / pop / peek and enqueue / dequeue / peek step by step with overflow, underflow, wrap-around and the list-queue's shifting, on-canvas buttons. Later (new beads): ring drawing, linked stack / queue, stack demos.

Four toggles in the style panel (TldrawUiToolbarToggleGroup type multiple; styles drawds:list-links / list-tail / list-ends / list-sentinel; props + cycleTo, migration with unit + e2e load check). Doubly: [prev | value | next] nodes, next and prev arrows in parallel lanes (none needed on vertical lists), null before the head. Tail label. Circular: the last arrow loops round (under a horizontal list / right of a vertical one, clear of the pointers) back to the first; doubly circular loops the first prev round the top, clear of the labels. Sentinel: dashed dummy node, head points at it. Pointer dots drawn at each arrow's real start. Switching keeps the head put; values, editing, grips work.

Find/insert/delete/reverse/middle/insert-in-order narrate every variant (doubly 4 assignments, tail updates, circular last.next, sentinel no special case); loops in operation frames; new nodes off the line away from the labels; head arrow curves round the old head; steps and bar hold still when the result moves the shape

Append (counted walk vs tail O(1); doubly, circular), Print the list (while / do-while round a circle / stop at the sentinel), Print backwards (tail, head.prev round a circle, or walk to the end first)
Make a cycle: last.next = X / Remove the cycle in a node's menu (one undo each); drawn as a rho loop; find stops at a node already seen; pointers step on into the cycle
All four variants (doubly, tail, circular, sentinel) plus cycles, with every operation narrated per variant
Is there a cycle? (slow and fast): phase 1 until fast runs off the end or they meet; phase 2 from the head and the meeting point to the cycle's start; steps counted

endTidied: list ops that change the list end on it drawn in line where the result puts it (anchorShift), so nothing moves on commit or Done and handles sit on their nodes; a closing remark that changes nothing moves onto that step

Lists get a Kind (list / stack / queue): top, front and rear labels, empty stacks and queues, push / pop / peek and enqueue / dequeue / peek step by step (rear = null when the last node goes), on-canvas buttons; circular/sentinel/cycles list-only
All children done: find, insert, delete, reverse, middle, insert in order, Floyd; plus append / print / variants

Dashed red rings on BST nodes out of order and heap values breaking the heap property (both views); a Check toggle (drawds:invariant, on by default) in the tree (BST) and heap panels; hidden while an operation is open
Swap a node's children and Mirror a subtree / the tree, in a plain tree's node menu, one undo each (pure swapChildren / mirrorSubtree; sideways drags flip)

Density (sparse / medium / dense), Pieces (connected / several: runs of the drag as if the pen were lifted) and, for directed graphs, Order (any / DAG along the drag) in the graph panel; shape new sketches and rewire a selected graph; defaults unchanged

Range picker under Fill (0-9, 0-99, 0-999, -50..50) on arrays, lists, trees and heaps (drawds:fill-range, migrations); regenerates selected values; growth and insertion stay in range; 3-character values shrink to fit

Matrix shape (Shift+M): drag a rectangle, indices, in-place editing (Tab / arrows), marks, grow grips, insert / delete rows and columns, instant transpose; step by step: row- vs column-major traversal with memory offsets, transpose across the diagonal, staircase search

Hash table (Shift+B): chaining or linear probing (switching re-inserts), hash worked out in captions (k mod m / char codes), insert / find / delete (tombstones) / grow-and-rehash step by step, load factor, misplaced keys ringed; key:value entries

Graph views: adjacency matrix (labels, 1/0 or weights, symmetric when undirected) and adjacency lists (array of list heads, label order = BFS/DFS order) as a linked graph-view shape from the graph's menu; live with edits, marks and operation highlights; deleted with the graph; View picker
PageDown/PageUp step the play bar like Right/Left (repeat while held, Shift+PageDown keeps highlights at the end), captured ahead of tldraw; tooltips name them; e2e in playback.e2e.ts

Main menu Open board / Save board / Save board as (Ctrl+O / Ctrl+S / Ctrl+Shift+S) as .tldr via tldraw's serializer and parser (migrations run on open); File System Access pickers in Chrome (Save writes back to the picked file, keyed by document meta so undoing an Open can't overwrite it), download + file input elsewhere; opening is one undo step with an Undo toast; tab title names the board. e2e/board-files.e2e.ts: every structure round-trips into a fresh profile, older schema migrates, bad file leaves the board alone.

Predict mode: a ? toggle on the play bar (remembered, drawds:predict). Stepping by hand, each step is first a question (Frame.ask, default 'What happens next?') over the step before, with askFocus elements pulsing violet (SceneSvg pulse); the next press reveals; back undoes one press at a time (pure stepFrom / shownFrame, unit-tested); Space / autoplay play straight through; nothing is asked once the result is in. Tailored, answer-neutral questions in BFS, DFS, BST insert and search, hash insert / find / delete. e2e/predict.e2e.ts.

Open operations make room for their steps: NodeLinkShapeUtil.withPlaybackRoom puts the union of every step's extent in meta.drawdsRoom (set on open, cleared around the commit and on close, history-ignored); the layout offset counts it, so onBeforeUpdate moves the shape and nothing shifts on the page, and the geometry gets internal corner points so the box holds every step. Caches keyed by props also key on meta / offset. clearStaleRooms on mount and after undo. bounds e2e: every step of list insert / insert-head / delete, heap insert and hash rehash inside the box with an untouched node still, plus undo.
